title: Altaian
summary: ALTA'IC, or ALTA'IAN, a. Pertaining to the Altai, a vast ridge of mountains extending, in an easterly direction, through a considerable part of Asia, and forming a boundary between the Russian and Chi

inlines.v: ALTA'IC, or ALTA'IAN, a. Pertaining to the Altai, a vast ridge of mountains extending, in an easterly direction, through a considerable part of Asia, and forming a boundary between the Russian and Chinese dominions.
